# Frisbi

> Frisbi is a luggage pickup and delivery service in Bangalore that transports bags between airports, hotels, and homes.

## Core Services & Booking

- [Rate Calculator](https://frisbi.in/rate-calculator): Calculate luggage transport pricing and request a pickup quote.
- [Book Shipment](https://frisbi.in/book-shipment): Schedule luggage pickup, transfer, and door-to-door delivery.
- [Corporate Booking](https://frisbi.in/book/corporate): Corporate luggage logistics solutions for business travelers and hotels.
- [Home Page](https://frisbi.in/): Overview of Frisbi's luggage transport and delivery services.

## Company Information

- [About Us](https://frisbi.in/about): Learn about Frisbi's mission and luggage delivery services.
- [Contact Us](https://frisbi.in/contact-us): Customer support and operational inquiries.

## Optional

- [Blog](https://frisbi.in/blog): Travel tips, packing guides, and service updates.
